projects.title: Buy Local
projects.description:
Following the Duaje tënden campaign, Albanian manufacturers and producers from Kosova, Albania and Northern Macedonia decided to take the promotion of Albanian made products to the next level, expanding geographically and increasing the range of products.

We branded the movement in 2014, identifying Albanian products in various fairs and other trade shows and events.

Blej Shqip and Duaje Tënden continue to be the most powerful local produce promoters in these countries to this day.
